relationships.subject: salidroside
relationships.evidence_quote: SAL inhibited the activation of the TXNIP/NLRP3 inflammasome axis and mitigated the neuronal loss of spinal dorsal horn induced by nerve injury.

relationships.subject: salidroside
relationships.evidence_quote: could ameliorate mechanical and thermal hypersensitivity in the CCI model

key_findings: Spinal TXNIP and NLRP3 inflammasome proteins rise 14-28 days after CCI in neurons and microglia; salidroside blocks this and reduces hypersensitivity.
